## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the fallback comes from the i18n path; ⛔ no English literal

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-30T14:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx` (`ScreenFieldInput`) ⇒ `domain:ui`.

**Re-read on objectui `origin/main`.** `ScreenView.tsx:388` has `placeholder={field.placeholder || 'Select…'}`.

**Why p3.** A hard-coded English word under every non-en locale, on a named producer (app-todo `screen_1` `category`), in the runtime `FlowRunner` dialog and the Studio preview. It is visible, but it breaks nothing.

**Direction.**
- The fallback reads a localized string through the i18n path `ScreenView` already uses for its other chrome. If the object form already has a "select…" placeholder key, reuse it. ⛔ No new literal list.
- **`config-field-renderer.tsx:138`**: measure whether it is user-facing. If it is, one key serves both sites; if not, say why it stays.
- `||` becomes `??`, so an authored empty placeholder is not replaced. The claim states which behaviour it keeps.
- **Pins:** under zh, a select with no `placeholder` shows the localized fallback; an authored `placeholder` renders verbatim (the control).

`finding` comes off at grading.

The dev stops on a breach and explains it in the report.

Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-30T17:24Z at objectui `origin/main` `b32e7debc8`. No open PR touches `ScreenView.tsx` or `config-field-renderer.tsx`. The one in-flight `area:workflow` card, objectui#10948 (seat 2), claims the flow designer's inspectors, `clientValidation.ts` and `flow-canvas-parts.tsx`, so its file surface is disjoint. PR objectui#11241 (this seat, landing) touches `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, which this card does not need.

Scope: triage's grade `5913805765`, in substance: the fallback reads a localized string through an existing i18n key, and an existing "select…" key is reused. ⛔ No new literal list. `||` becomes `??`. For `config-field-renderer.tsx:138`, measure whether it is user-facing; one key serves both sites, or the report says why the second stays. Pins: under zh, a select with no `placeholder` shows the localized fallback; an authored `placeholder` renders verbatim. PR says `Fixes #11220`.
`Clause-②: no` — why: a localized fallback for a word the product already shows. No declared input, export or prop type changes. If the measured route needs a new published prop on `@object-ui/components`, the dev reports it and this line is re-judged at review.
